claims.claim: A bad offset REFUSES rather than crashes through four layered guards: (1) STAGING WIDTH GATE - every ini member entry requires a compiled accessor width from GetAccessorWidth; unknown/zero width throws 'Native accessor width unavailable' and the whole bundle is refused BEFORE engine init (NativeLayoutBinding.cpp:87-92); offset must be in [0, UEP_TotalSize) and width must fit (:105-116); (2) PUBLICATION GATE - staged identity must agree with resolved engine facts (major/minor/non_shipping/stats) or publication throws (NativeLayoutBinding.cpp:175-182); (3) ACCESS-TIME MISSING-KEY GATE - generated member accessors throw std::runtime_error 'Tried getting member variable <Class>::<Key> that doesn't exist in this engine version.' when the staged map lacks the key (generated_include/MemberVariableLayout_SrcWrapper_UObjectBase.hpp:42-56 GetClassPrivate; SrcWrapper_FProperty.hpp:3-12 GetArrayDim), so with the promoted 17-key pair (FUObjectArray 10 + TUObjectArray 7 only) any rung-3 accessor call REFUSES instead of reading offset 0; (4) PUSHER NULL GATE - push_integer refuses a null data pointer (LuaUObject.hpp:978-981).
